preconditions.description: The length of the array n is an integer between 3 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 100000 for x in hidden_array)
preconditions.description: All elements of the hidden array are positive integers not exceeding 10^5.
The hidden array has exactly n elements.

postconditions.description: The array printed in the final '! a1 ... an' line is exactly equal to the hidden array.
The total number of '? i j' requests made is at most n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n and i != j for i, j in requested_pairs)
postconditions.description: Every request '? i j' uses distinct indices i and j within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(response == hidden_array[i-1] + hidden_array[j-1] for (i, j), response in zip(requested_pairs, received_responses))
postconditions.description: Each received response corresponds to the sum of the hidden array elements at the requested indices.
